en: So to give this a try, we can open the chat
because our input here is this built-in chat
node.
And now we got a little chat here on the
side and we can send anything to the model.
We could ask, what can you do for me?
And if I do that and we send this off, we
can see the model is thinking and we got
back a response and no tool was called. We
can tell that no tool was called because the
nodes that were active are now green if they
were successful, red if they failed. But if
they're neither, they were not used. And
that makes sense because for my question,
what can you do for me? I wouldn't expect
the model to decide to use any tools. I just
wanted it to tell me what it can do. And
indeed it tells me that it can summarize
articles and so on. It tells me about its
capabilities, but it didn't do anything,
which makes sense.
So now let's clear this. Let's send a new
message.
Please summarize
this text.
And now I'll paste in some text.
And for that you can use, for example, the
README file, or again, this
what-are-workflows.md file you find
attached. So in the project you found
attached, copy that, not the file, but the
content, paste that in here.
And now send this. So I sent this off and
now we can see the model is thinking and the
agent node will handle any tool call
requests coming back from the model and will
invoke the tools and handle the loop. So now
the summarize text tool was invoked because
the model certainly requested that.
It finished successfully. Response by the
tool was sent back to the loop, was sent
back to the
model, and that model then handled it, then
decided that it doesn't need to do anything
else and instead finished its task. The
agent realized that, and here we can see the
final output, which includes that summary.
Now another example would be if I would ask
it to summarize and store in a
PDF file. So I'll paste in the same message
from before, but now I'll edit it and say,
please summarize this text
and save to a PDF file
like this.
And if I now send this, we should see that
of course the same agent loop starts off
again and the model thinks and the summarize
text tool should be called because the model
decides that it needs to call that.
And yes,
that is what happened.
And then the response gets back to the
model, but now, yep, it decided to also call
Create PDF because again, that makes sense
for this task. Now it's done.
And in the project folder under Generated
PDF, we can see that PDF file. And if I were
to open this PDF, that is what it looks
like.
And that is an example for how you could
visually build such an agent. And of course
you can add more tools. You can build your
own agent and play around with these tools
and attach them to see what different tools
allow different agents to do.
